title: annona neoecuadorensis
intro: Annona neoecuadorensis, commonly known as the Ecuadorian custard apple, is a species of flowering plant in the Annonaceae family. This plant is reported to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Annona neoecuadorensis include its potential to exhibit neuroprotective, hepatoprotective, and anti-cancer properties, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and modern research. The bioactive constituents of this plant include annonaceous acetogenins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential to inhibit cancer cell growth and proliferation.
